attrs.aria-label: Indican plus water gives indoxyl plus glucose. Drawn structures: indican is indoxyl joined through its oxygen to a glucose ring; after the enzyme, the indoxyl carries an O H and the glucose an O H of its own.

equation.label: Two indoxyl plus oxygen give indigo plus two water

attrs.aria-label: Two indoxyl plus oxygen give one indigo plus two water. The two indoxyl halves slide together; each loses the hydrogen on its oxygen and on its second carbon, a double bond joins them, and each oxygen becomes C double bond O.
